# Merge Candy — privacy policy

Public pages for store review, served by GitHub Pages:

- Privacy Policy: https://ahsankhan-art.github.io/merge-candy-privacy-url/
- Terms of Use: https://ahsankhan-art.github.io/merge-candy-privacy-url/terms.html

**Generated — do not edit by hand.** The text lives in the game repo at `src/data/legal.ts`; run
